title: Frame the independent Math M8-M12 roadmap while preserving the completed M0-M7 contract
commitMessage: docs: qualify proposed M8-M12 Math roadmap and DWF topology gate

contribution.summary: Record the owner-approved post-M7 Math roadmap in the agreed M8-to-M12 order, with independent Discovery and .NET 11 modernization streams.
contribution.value: Produce a five-milestone, ten-stream structured proposal with bounded acceptance and nonclaims, a readable rationale, and a C# structural gate. Retain canonical backlog 0.1.122, 541 completed native nodes, existing NuGet artifacts and independent AURA boundaries unchanged.
debtChanges: RS178 succeeded on attempt 001 after two pre-attempt workflow refusals; first-pass is false. Its unsent AURA coordination dossier remains intact.
The new roadmap is owner-approved direction, not a new implemented or native-admitted milestone. Current M0-M7 accepted status remains done.
Workflow GitHub source now contains typed milestone and work-package subtree authors, but operator DWF 0.1.66 compatibility remains unverified. No direct plan JSON editing.
Discovery protocol, four candidate CLR capabilities and the existing M3-W03 proposal remain candidates; no generated Math skill or BrokerReady capability is claimed.
Modernization evaluates .NET 11 and C# 15 on separately qualified SDK and packages; no implicit upgrade of historical immutable net10 assets.
contribution.nextAction: After durable success, qualify the installed DWF native-topology authoring contract and then admit the first M8 scope with reconciled backlog/plan/validators in a separate bounded run.
